# `remove_dependency`

**Remove Dependency.** Remove a dependency edge: *task_id* no longer depends on *depends_on*.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `remove_dependency` |
| Side effect | `composite` |
| Idempotency | none |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `task_id` | `string` | yes | — | The downstream task to unlink |
